_comment: Meaning of single bits in flag bytes, by RAM or calibration name: {name: {bit: text}}. tools/gen_source.py puts the text after each BSET/BCLR/BRSET/BRCLR on that bit. FaultSetNN/FaultMemNN bits come from the fault table itself.

AcFlags.7: A/C clutch engaged (AcClutchControl); set at reset
AcFlags.6: A/C engaged for idle and purge test (AcClutchControl), cleared separately from bit 7
AcFlags.5: A/C idle step active (IdleTargetControl); set at reset
AcFlags.4: A/C idle bump pending, probably (IdleTargetControl); set at reset
AcFlags.3: A/C request from the bus (message bit 0 in CcdReceive)
AcFlags.2: bus message bit 4 (CcdReceive / PciReceive), read by AcClutchControl and the purge test
AcFlags.1: A/C clutch output changed since the last pass (AcCutLogic)

BusModuleFlags.7: transmission module message seen on the bus (CcdReceive, PciReceive)
BusModuleFlags.6: new transmission status received (TransBusStatus), not handled yet by TransMilRequest
BusModuleFlags.1: body/transmission bus message timed out (BodyBusTimeout); cleared by each received message
BusModuleFlags.0: transmission fault with a MIL request pending (TransMilRequest, TransFaultStore)

BusReqFlags.4: bus A/C or fan request held: throttle below BusReqThrottleMax when it came (CcdReceive, timed by BusReqTimerTick)
BusReqFlags.3: MAP-high flag changed since the last message (MapHighBusFlag)
BusReqFlags.2: MAP high: MAP above the baro/rpm threshold (MapHighBusFlag, hysteresis BusMapHyst)
BusReqFlags.1: bus message bit 6 (CcdReceive); set on a body bus timeout
BusReqFlags.0: bus message status bits = $80 (CcdReceive); set on a body bus timeout

BusTxRequest.7: send the reply to bus message $C8 (set by CcdReceive, cleared when PciService sends it)
BusTxRequest.6: send the security message (BusTxSecurity); set at reset
BusTxRequest.5: send the per-event spark message (set in Isr_GPT_IC4OC5)
BusTxRequest.4: send the spark status message (set in Isr_GPT_IC4OC5)
BusTxRequest.3: send message $91 (BusTxMsg91); set when the MAP-high bus flag changes (MapHighBusFlag)
BusTxRequest.1: speed control switch state changed: send it (speed control switch code)
BusTxRequest.0: PCI link data changed: send it (PciLinkCheck)

CcdBusFlags.7: bus ready for the next message (CcdReceive, Irq4BusHandler, Irq2BusHandler)
CcdBusFlags.5: echo of the sent byte matched (Irq4BusHandler)
CcdBusFlags.4: echo mismatch or receive error: arbitration lost (Irq4BusHandler)
CcdBusFlags.3: message sent with a receive copy (BusTxStart, CcdRxFlags bit 7)
CcdBusFlags.2: last byte of the message sent (Irq4BusHandler)
CcdBusFlags.0: received message goes to the second buffer (Irq4BusHandler, Irq2BusHandler)

ChargeMonFlags.7: charging voltage short of the target by more than FieldVoltsStep (ChargeControl)
ChargeMonFlags.6: charging low long enough to fail (ChargeMonFailTime reached, ChargeLowMonitor)
ChargeMonFlags.5: generator field output on (mirrors IoDriver6E bit 13; Isr_PIT, ChargeControl)
ChargeMonFlags.4: engine rpm above FieldRpmMin: field ramp started (FieldRampControl)
ChargeMonFlags.3: charging low for ChargeMonTime: monitor armed (ChargeLowMonitor)
ChargeMonFlags.2: battery voltage low (BattLowVolts for BattLowSetCount passes, BatteryLowFlag); charge lamp
ChargeMonFlags.0: a fault with the charge-lamp flag was reported (ReportFault); charge lamp request

ClosedLoopMonFlags.7: adaptive memory cleared for the fuel system monitors this drive cycle (ClosedLoopMemClear)
ClosedLoopMonFlags.6: run time since start past the stored limit ($0641,Z): misfire monitoring allowed (ClosedLoopMonTimer)

ControlFlags943.6: set while an actuator test step runs (ActuatorTestMain, OutputTestOcFire)
ControlFlags943.4: ASD relay on, probably: set with bit 3 for the key-on prime (RunModeSwitch), cleared at stall; circuit checks of ASD-powered outputs read it
ControlFlags943.3: fuel pump relay on, probably (set and cleared with bit 4)
ControlFlags943.2: output toggled by EgrOutputTest, not read
ControlFlags943.0: A/C clutch relay on (AcCutLogic); the idle code reads it

ControlFlags944.7: set and cleared by DiagModeInit from ControlFlagsC39 bit 3 (opposite of PciFlags6 bit 7)
ControlFlags944.5: output toggled by EgrOutputTest (with ControlFlags943 bit 2), not read
ControlFlags944.4: radiator fan relay, probably (FanControl, BusTempFlag, output test)
ControlFlags944.3: second fan relay, probably; driven only with A/C fitted

ControlFlagsC33.6: hot-coolant idle step active (IdleTargetControl, IacShiftStepApply); read by spark trim and purge test
ControlFlagsC33.4: fuel trim adjust value differs from the stored copy (Reset, FuelTrimAdjustStore)
ControlFlagsC33.2: hot-coolant idle state (cleared with bit 6); read by spark trim, purge test, fan PWM
ControlFlagsC33.0: MIL lamp check done since the engine started (MilLampUpdate)

ControlFlagsC39.7: PCI link variant: set at reset from the bus configuration, cleared when the link check fails
ControlFlagsC39.4: transmission MIL request (BusModuleFlags bit 0, DiagModeUpdate); EGR and OBD code read it
ControlFlagsC39.3: diagnostic mode bit mirrored into ControlFlags944 bit 7 (DiagModeInit)

CrankFlags2.7: reference event seen since the last PIT check (Isr_GPT_IC1, HighRpmTimerPit)
CrankFlags2.5: vehicle speed or bus speed value high (Isr_GPT_IC3); HighRpmTimerUpdate counts
CrankFlags2.3: VSS period long ($07D0 or more) not seen (Isr_GPT_IC3); HighRpmTimerUpdate counts HighRpmTimer2
CrankFlags2.1: engine rpm below $1900: HighRpmTimer counting (HighRpmTimerPit); AsdRelayCheck and others read it

CrankSyncFlags.7: crank/cam synchronised (set with bit 2 as $84 by Isr_GPT_PAI)
CrankSyncFlags.6: at least one reference event since the engine started turning (Isr_GPT_IC1)
CrankSyncFlags.5: pulse accumulator not in gated mode at the cam edge (Isr_GPT_PAI): cylinder index taken from PORTGP
CrankSyncFlags.2: set with bit 7 by Isr_GPT_PAI ($84 = synchronised)

DiagStatusFlags.7: fault with a MIL request being processed, probably (ObdFaultProcess, cleared by MilRequest)
DiagStatusFlags.6: a fault aged out this pass, probably (ObdFaultAging)
DiagStatusFlags.4: misfire record taken (MisfireCount), cleared by DiagModeTimer
DiagStatusFlags.3: misfire record taken (MisfireCount), cleared by MilRequest and DiagModeTimer
DiagStatusFlags.1: cleared by ObdMonitorMain and at reset, set by byte writes; monitors read it
DiagStatusFlags.0: cleared by ObdMonitorMain and at reset, set by byte writes; monitors read it

DriveFlags.7: drive engagement handling in progress (GearStateUpdate), probably
DriveFlags.6: power steering pressure switch active: bit 6 of the switch bits collected from IoInputs0 (map chosen by $032D), unless P0551 is set (SwitchInputsRead)
DriveFlags.5: transmission in gear (park/neutral switch), automatic only (calibration bit $032E.6 clear)
DriveFlags.2: crank and cam synchronised since key-on (Isr_GPT_PAI)
DriveFlags.1: reference pulses seen since key-on (Isr_GPT_IC1); MapKeyOnCheck needs it clear
DriveFlags.0: the active adaptive cell is the idle cell PurgeCell1 (UpdateDriveFlags)

EepromFlags.7: EEPROM write requested: EepromData to EepromAddr (callers wait while it is set)
EepromFlags.6: word write: two bytes to write (set with bit 7 by NvWriteRequest, SriMileageStore)
EepromFlags.4: second byte of a word write in progress (EepromWriteService)
EepromFlags.3: bus message $91 write request, first kind (BusEepromWrite -> EepromWriteQueue)
EepromFlags.2: bus message $91 write request, second kind (BusEepromWrite -> EepromWriteQueue)
EepromFlags.1: write retry pending, retry count at $094B,Z (EepromWriteService)
EepromFlags.0: write started, waiting for the EEPROM to finish (EepromWriteService)

EgrFlags.5: EGR held off by a stored EGR-related fault (FaultMem04 bit 6 or FaultMem03 bit 1)
EgrFlags.4: coolant above EgrCoolantOn (off again below EgrCoolantOff)
EgrFlags.3: warm start: start coolant at or below EgrStartWarmMax, start delay running
EgrFlags.2: cold start: start coolant at or below EgrStartColdMax, waits for the O2 warm-up delay
EgrFlags.1: EGR on long enough (EgrOnTimer past EgrOnDelay): the fuel and spark corrections for EGR apply

EngineStateFlags.7: engine turning: set at the first reference pulse, cleared when the engine stalls (CalcEngineRpm)
EngineStateFlags.4: start fuel prime done, or hot restart (coolant at reset at or above HotRestartCoolantMin); read by CrankFuel
EngineStateFlags.3: cleared at stall only, never set in 05293190AC
EngineStateFlags.2: cleared at stall only, never set in 05293190AC
EngineStateFlags.1: cleared at stall only, never set in 05293190AC
EngineStateFlags.0: first reference pulse seen, start pulse still due (cleared by StartInjectorPulse)

EquipmentFlags.5: automatic transmission: calibration bit $032E.5, or the transmission module seen on the bus
EquipmentFlags.3: copy of calibration bit $033E.1 at reset; not read
EquipmentFlags.2: power steering pressure switch fitted (calibration bit $0331.3, or EquipmentDetect)
EquipmentFlags.1: copy of calibration bit $0335.3 at reset; not read
EquipmentFlags.0: copy of calibration bit $0330.4 at reset; not read

EventSparkFlags.7: per-event spark state A, set with bit 3 by Isr_GPT_IC4OC5 when SwitchInputs2 bit 5 is set; reported on the bus
EventSparkFlags.6: per-event spark state B, set with bit 2 (the opposite of bit 7); reported on the bus
EventSparkFlags.5: per-event history to be refilled (Isr_GPT_IC4OC5, cleared by EventTableCheck)
EventSparkFlags.4: per-event spark restart: timers cleared (Isr_GPT_IC4OC5); EventSparkControl reads it
EventSparkFlags.0: input capture 4 edge was the first kind (TCTL2 bit 7 clear) (Isr_GPT_IC4OC5)

FanFlags.3: fan idle state: engine idling, idle timer counting (FanIdleState)
FanFlags.1: fan PWM output read back low (FanPwmOutputCheck)
FanFlags.0: fan PWM output read back high (FanPwmOutputCheck)

FieldFlags.6: field ramp minimum time after start passed (FieldRampTimeMin)
FieldFlags.5: field ramp reached its end step (FieldRampControl)
FieldFlags.4: field ramp held at a fixed duty (FieldRampControl)
FieldFlags.3: field ramp active (FieldRampControl); ChargeControl and BatteryLowFlag read it
FieldFlags.1: idle air charge step: voltage recovered, timer running (IacChargeStepCalc)

FlexLearnFlags.7: cold start: coolant below FlexLearnColdCoolantMax at the start of learning (FlexColdStart)
FlexLearnFlags.5: refuel detected: fuel level rose or was below FlexRefuelLevelMax at start (FlexLearnMain, FlexLearnInitRun)
FlexLearnFlags.4: enough fuel used since the refuel (FlexLearnFuelSum past FlexRefuelFuelMin): new fuel reached the engine
FlexLearnFlags.1: closed-loop flex trim allowed: run time past O2FlexRunTimeMin (ClosedLoopManager)

FlexLearnFlags6.7: flex learning time limit reached (FlexLearnTimeCount past FlexLearnTimeMax)
FlexLearnFlags6.4: cleared with bit 5 by the idle learning steps
FlexLearnFlags6.3: cold purge learning allowed (FlexColdStart, read by FlexColdPurge)
FlexLearnFlags6.2: upstream O2 active for flex learning (FlexColdStart, FlexIdleEnable); read by FlexPulseTrim
FlexLearnFlags6.1: learning restarted (set when FlexLearnFlags6 is reset)

FlexLearnFlags7.7: cleared by FlexLearnMain at the end of a learning pass
FlexLearnFlags7.5: flex estimate reset or refuel: closed-loop learning restarts (FlexLearnMain; read by O2LearnEnable)
FlexLearnFlags7.4: flex learning running with O2 active: purge duty and vapour learn wait (PurgeDutySelect, PurgeVaporLearn)

FuelModeFlags.7: idle air fuel adder above its lookup value (IacFuelControl); read by Isr_GPT_IC1
FuelModeFlags.4: crank pulse taken from the coolant table (FuelEventCalc)
FuelModeFlags.3: per-event spark/fuel history to be updated (set in Isr_GPT_IC4OC5, cleared by EventTableCheck)
FuelModeFlags.2: vehicle speed above the warm-up fuel speed limit (WarmupFuel)
FuelModeFlags.0: WOT enrichment delay elapsed: WOT enrichment on (WotEnrichControl)

FuelModeFlags2.7: byte writes only; read by the event fuel, spark, misfire and purge code
FuelModeFlags2.6: byte writes only; read by tip-in fuel, event corrections and purge
FuelModeFlags2.5: throttle closed quickly: deceleration fuel cut armed (FuelCutControl)
FuelModeFlags2.3: idle enrichment active: MAP below IdleFuelMapMax (IdleEnrichment)
FuelModeFlags2.0: engine-off time received from the bus (CcdReceive, PciReceive)

FuelPulseFlags.7: injector timers loaded for the current event (FuelEventCalc), probably
FuelPulseFlags.6: set in FuelEventCalc for event code $42, cleared for the others
FuelPulseFlags.5: first pass of the fuel event code done (FuelEventCalc)
FuelPulseFlags.2: sequential fuel started (FuelEventCalc); read by the start and event code
FuelPulseFlags.1: cleared at stall; read by InjectorSequence

FuelSysFlags1.7: lean (adaptive at its lower limit) for FuelSysLeanCount passes: lean monitor armed, bank 1
FuelSysFlags1.6: adaptive at its lower limit (O2AdaptMin) this pass, bank 1
FuelSysFlags1.4: lean condition counted in the current window, bank 1
FuelSysFlags1.3: rich (adaptive at its upper limit) for FuelSysRichCount passes: rich monitor armed, bank 1
FuelSysFlags1.2: adaptive at its upper limit (O2AdaptMax / O2AdaptCellMax) this pass, bank 1
FuelSysFlags1.0: rich condition counted in the current window, bank 1

FuelSysFlags2.7: lean (adaptive at its lower limit) for FuelSysLeanCount passes: lean monitor armed, bank 2
FuelSysFlags2.6: adaptive at its lower limit (O2AdaptMin) this pass, bank 2
FuelSysFlags2.4: lean condition counted in the current window, bank 2
FuelSysFlags2.3: rich (adaptive at its upper limit) for FuelSysRichCount passes: rich monitor armed, bank 2
FuelSysFlags2.2: adaptive at its upper limit (O2AdaptMax / O2AdaptCellMax) this pass, bank 2
FuelSysFlags2.0: rich condition counted in the current window, bank 2

GearStateFlags.7: gear engaged and shift idle delay done (GearStateUpdate)
GearStateFlags.6: start: no gear message from the bus yet (set at start by IacResetHold, cleared by GearStateUpdate or a bus timeout)
GearStateFlags.5: bus gear message: not in drive (CcdReceive)
GearStateFlags.3: gear message received from the bus (CcdReceive, PciReceive)
GearStateFlags.2: set with bit 7 when the shift idle delay ends (GearStateUpdate)

IacAcFlags.7: A/C clutch spark hold during a shift step (AcClutchSpark)
IacAcFlags.6: A/C clutch spark hold time reached (AcClutchSpark)
IacAcFlags.4: idle air A/C step applied (IdleTargetControl, AcCutLogic)
IacAcFlags.3: A/C request from the transmission module on the bus (IdleTargetControl)
IacAcFlags.2: bus message bit 5 (CcdReceive, PciReceive), read by IdleTargetControl
IacAcFlags.1: rpm filter from the bus value (RpmIdleFilter, BusFlags9CE bit 6)
IacAcFlags.0: A/C clutch spark rate step (AcClutchSpark, read by AcSparkRate)

IacStepFlags.6: stepper hold requested by a diagnostic routine (JumpTable_35BB0), cleared by IacStepperDrive
IacStepFlags.5: start hold of the idle air control active (IacCrankControl, IacResetHold)
IacStepFlags.4: idle air at the fixed target (IacFixedTarget)
IacStepFlags.2: diagnostic idle air command active (IdleRpmTarget, DiagCommand)
IacStepFlags.1: idle air target from the MAP loop instead of the fixed command (IdleControl)
IacStepFlags.0: rolling idle control active, probably (IacRollingControl); IdleStateUpdate treats it as off-idle

IdleAcFlags.7: A/C idle step active (IdleTargetControl); AcClutchControl reads it
IdleAcFlags.6: set with bit 7 when the A/C idle step starts
IdleAcFlags.3: A/C state bit cleared by IdleTargetControl and AcCutLogic

IdleFlags.7: closed throttle while rolling at or above IdleRollSpeed (coast), or IacStepFlags bit 0 (IdleStateUpdate)
IdleFlags.6: set and cleared by IdleRpmTarget, read by idle, closed-loop trim and purge test; meaning not settled
IdleFlags.4: idle air target set from the coolant branch of IdleTargetControl, probably; read by IacLearn
IdleFlags.0: idle rpm loop hold timer started (IdleRpmLoop)

IdleFlags2.7: shift idle timer running (IacShiftTimer not zero, IdleTargetControl)
IdleFlags2.6: idle target ramp not allowed: flex cold start or ramp delay (IdleRpmTarget)
IdleFlags2.4: idle at the previous pass (ThrottleState bit 0, IdleRpmTarget)
IdleFlags2.3: idle target raise, cause 4 (IdleRpmTarget, with IdleFlags bit 6)
IdleFlags2.2: idle target raise for low battery voltage (BatteryVoltsFiltered, IdleRpmTarget)

IdleFlags3.6: reference event since the last idle loop pass (set in Isr_GPT_IC1, cleared by IdleRpmLoop)
IdleFlags3.5: idle step after shift requested (IdleRpmTarget; cleared when SegmentRpm passes IacGearRpmEnd)
IdleFlags3.4: A/C idle bump waiting for the clutch (IdleTargetControl)
IdleFlags3.3: SegmentRpm below the gear-step rpm (IdleTargetControl, GearStateUpdate)
IdleFlags3.2: closed-throttle coast seen (IdleStateUpdate; cleared by IacRollingControl)
IdleFlags3.0: throttle closed since the last opening: dashpot started (ThrottleClosedLearn)

IdleFlags5.6: idle MAP target step allowed (IdleMapTargetCalc); IdleRpmLoop watches it
IdleFlags5.4: idle step state, cleared with IdleFlags bits 2-3 (IdleTargetControl)
IdleFlags5.3: idle step state, cleared with IdleFlags bits 2-3 (IdleTargetControl)
IdleFlags5.2: shift idle step applied (IacShiftStepApply in IdleTargetControl)
IdleFlags5.1: idle air position set by the MAP loop (IdleMapLoop)
IdleFlags5.0: MAP target in acceleration phase (IdleMapTargetCalc, IdleMapRpmAccelMax)

IdleFlags6.7: vehicle speed below the MAP-loop speed limit (IdleMapLoop)
IdleFlags6.6: idle air learning allowed: no flex cold start (IacLearn)
IdleFlags6.5: rolling idle control was active at the last pass (IacStepFlags bit 0, IdleRpmTarget)
IdleFlags6.2: idle step state, cleared with IdleFlags5 bits 3-4 (IdleTargetControl)
IdleFlags6.0: A/C sensor value latched before the clutch engaged (IacBaseCalc)

IdleFlags7.6: reference period long (RefPeriod at $20 or more, low rpm): idle air crank target (CalcEngineRpm, IacCrankControl)
IdleFlags7.5: idle conditions met without a recent shift (IdleStateFlags)
IdleFlags7.4: idle target raise for low battery voltage or a diagnostic hold (IdleRpmTarget)
IdleFlags7.3: cleared with bits 7 and 2 when the gear step ends; not set by bit instructions
IdleFlags7.2: cleared with bits 7 and 3 when the gear step ends; not set by bit instructions
IdleFlags7.1: A/C idle bump not handled yet (IdleTargetControl)
IdleFlags7.0: SegmentRpm above $7D00 (overrun of the idle loop range; hysteresis to $7C60) (IdleRpmLoop)

IdleFlags8.5: idle air start hold active (IacStepFlags bit 5, IdleRpmLoop)
IdleFlags8.3: MAP target step allowed (IdleFlags5 bit 6, IdleRpmLoop)
IdleFlags8.2: one of bits 3-7 just ended: idle loop restarts its terms (IdleRpmLoop)
IdleFlags8.1: gear idle steps still to apply (IdleTargetControl); FanRelayControl reads it
IdleFlags8.0: hot air: AirTemp above IdleHotAirOn, off below IdleHotAirOff (IdleRpmTarget)

IoBusStatusL.7: tested by BusTxStart before a byte is sent

IoCfg1FL.4: manifold tuning valve driver status (MtvCheck, MtvTiming)
IoCfg1FL.3: tested by Isr_GPT_OC4 (ignition driver status, probably)
IoCfg1FL.2: tested by Isr_GPT_OC3 (ignition driver status, probably)
IoCfg1FL.1: tested by Isr_GPT_OC2 (ignition driver status, probably)

IoDriver62.5: leak detection pump solenoid on (word bit 13)

IoDriver64.5: speed control lamp / PWM C18 output on (word bit 13)

IoDriver66.5: second tuning valve / speed control output on (word bit 13)

IoDriver68.5: fan output on (word bit 13; output test)

IoDriver6E.5: generator field output on (word bit 13; ChargeControl, Isr_PIT)

IoInputs0.3: key off, probably: the monitors skip while it is set and CheckPowerDown starts the power-down path
IoInputs0.2: ASD relay output present, probably (AsdRelayCheck, the reference-event code)

IoInputs1.1: leak detection pump solenoid driver feedback (LdpSolenoidCheck)

IoIrqEnable.3: bus timer interrupt enable (word bit 11; PciTimeoutRestart sets it)

IoIrqStatus.1: timer event: Isr_IRQ2 counts it in Irq2Counter for the misfire segment times

IoStatus0B.3: bus transmitter busy, probably (CCD/PCI transmit code waits on it)

LdpFlags.6: large leak: pump strokes faster than LdpLargeLeakStrokeTime
LdpFlags.5: leak test step result: small leak or not settled, probably
LdpFlags.3: pump step ended (LDP state machine, LdpMonitor voltage check)
LdpFlags.2: pump switch closed in the current step (IoInputs0 bit 1)
LdpFlags.0: pump solenoid commanded on (LDP state machine); LdpSolenoidCheck reads it

LdpFlags3.7: MonData643Update first pass done (counter MonData643 cleared)
LdpFlags3.3: MonTaskC phase 2: ASD relay held off (ControlFlags943 bit 4), probably part of a key-off test

LdpPurgeTestFlags.6: sign of the last change in LdpPurgeTest
LdpPurgeTestFlags.5: idle phase of the purge test reached (LdpPurgeTest)
LdpPurgeTestFlags.4: purge test finished: purge duty back to zero; monitors wait until then
LdpPurgeTestFlags.2: purge test requested (LdpPurgeTestRun); monitors hold off while it runs
LdpPurgeTestFlags.1: second kind of purge test request, or result stored (LdpPurgeTestRun, LdpPurgeTest)
LdpPurgeTestFlags.0: third kind of purge test request (LdpPurgeTestRun)

MainLoopPhaseMask.7: one pass in 256 (about 3.1 s); the mask holds the trailing one bits of MainLoopCounter

MisfireFlags.7: misfire deviation armed (MisfireDeviation, from MisfireFlags4 bit 1)
MisfireFlags.6: misfire record active; cleared with the records (MisfireFaultRecord, ObdFaultAging, ObdClearCodes)
MisfireFlags.5: crankshaft change above the noise level while closed-loop monitoring allows it (MisfireTransient)
MisfireFlags.4: misfire noise peak at or below its limit (MisfireEnableMain)
MisfireFlags.3: misfire monitor enabled for this event (MisfireEnableCheck in MisfireMonitorEvent)
MisfireFlags.1: cleared with the misfire records; read by MisfireCount

MisfireFlags2.6: throttle open state seen by the misfire transient filter (MisfireTransient)
MisfireFlags2.4: misfire count limit reached (MisfireCountLimit, MisfireCount); closed loop and fuel system status read it
MisfireFlags2.1: misfire monitor blocked by the second condition table at $3C6E (MisfireEnableCheck)
MisfireFlags2.0: misfire monitor blocked by the condition table at $3C31 (MisfireEnableCheck)

MisfireFlags4.6: set by IdleTargetControl at the end of a gear idle step; read by MisfireDeviation

MisfireOptions.7: MisfireFlags2 bit 4 handling in ClosedLoopManager and FuelSystemStatus
MisfireOptions.2: selects a branch in MisfireSegmentTime and MisfireDevCalc

MonEnableFlags2.7: monitor data valid for this drive cycle (MonEnableCheck); read by many monitors
MonEnableFlags2.6: monitor data to be reset (set at reset and by MonEnableCheck)
MonEnableFlags2.5: monitor data changed: to be written to the EEPROM (MonDataStore)
MonEnableFlags2.0: misfire threshold in the closed-loop range (MisfireThreshold)

MonitorDisableFlags.5: flex-fuel learning hold active (FlexLearnHold not zero): misfire, catalyst, O2, EGR, purge and leak monitors wait
MonitorDisableFlags.3: fuel level outside the monitor window (MonEnableFuelLow)
MonitorDisableFlags.2: battery voltage at or below MonEnableVoltsMin

O2ActiveFlags.7: upstream O2 sensor 1 active: output passed O2ActiveLow (latched, cleared when closed loop restarts)
O2ActiveFlags.5: downstream O2 sensor 1 active: output passed O2DownActiveLow
O2ActiveFlags.3: as bit 7, but cleared when O2CheckEnable disables the sensor (SensorFaultFlags2 bit 3)
O2ActiveFlags.2: as bit 6, cleared by SensorFaultFlags2 bit 2
O2ActiveFlags.1: as bit 5, cleared by SensorFaultFlags2 bit 1
O2ActiveFlags.0: as bit 4, cleared by SensorFaultFlags2 bit 0

O2ResetFlags.3: cold enrichment active when closed loop started (ClosedLoopManager)

Options0328.1: security variant: selects a branch in SecurityState
Options0328.0: SKIM immobiliser handling off (SkimState skips when set)

Options032A.7: engine/ignition variant used by the event, spark, knock and rpm code
Options032A.6: engine variant used by the event, fuel accounting and misfire code (cylinder layout, probably)
Options032A.5: hardware set-up variant at reset (Reset, HardwareCheck)

Options032B.7: event layout variant: segment times, fuel accounting, spark events
Options032B.6: dwell from the battery-voltage table on (DwellBatteryOn); also selects output-compare channels 2-4 in the spark and knock code
Options032B.5: spark calculation hook on (SparkCalcHookOn); also used by dwell and cam/crank measurement

Options032C.7: closed loop off: ClosedLoopMain clears the O2 state and the short-term trim
Options032C.6: flex-fuel (ethanol) calibration: FlexEthanol and the flex learning are used

Options032D.7: selects branches in SwitchInputsRead, SecurityStatusCalc, SciSendByte and AcClutchControl
Options032D.6: fan output variant (FanStatusByte, FanRelayControl, output tests)
Options032D.5: A/C clutch logic on (AcClutchLogicOn); also selects the switch-input map, the VSS constants and the speed control lamp
Options032D.4: board variant used by O2UpdateUpstream, SciSendByte and QspiOutputStatus
Options032D.3: board variant: switch-input map (SwitchBitsCollect), O2UpdateUpstream, SciSendByte, QspiOutputStatus

Options032E.6: manual transmission: GearStateUpdate and the park/neutral monitor are skipped
Options032E.5: transmission controller on the bus (sets EquipmentFlags bit 5)
Options032E.2: PCI bus (J1850, probably) instead of CCD: PciReceive / PciPitTick run instead of CcdReceive / CcdTransmit

Options032F.7: upstream O2 sensor 1 fitted (pairs with O2ActiveFlags bits 7/3 and Options033F bit 7)
Options032F.3: selects branches in the fuel event, closed-loop timing, idle and flex code
Options032F.2: knock sensor variant (knock sample, retard, learn and spark code)

Options0330.5: tip-in air temperature check on (TipInAirTempCheck); also used by SparkHook and PurgeMonitorArm
Options0330.4: catalyst temperature sensor fitted (CatTempMonitor; sets EquipmentFlags bit 0)
Options0330.3: battery temperature sensor check variant (both branches exist in BatteryTempSensorCheck)
Options0330.0: battery temperature model on (BattTempModelOn); PciReceive also reads it

Options0331.7: A/C pressure sensor fitted, not a switch (AcPressureSensor): idle A/C steps, clutch, cut and fan
Options0331.4: fuel level from the bus instead of the sender, probably
Options0331.3: power steering pressure switch fitted (sets EquipmentFlags bit 2)

Options0332.2: speed control switch variant; also used by EquipmentDetect
Options0332.1: speed control switch variant; also used by EquipmentDetect

Options0334.4: PWM fan output: output-compare set-up at reset and in the PIT code

Options0335.7: second tuning valve fitted (TuneValve2Control in the PIT code)
Options0335.5: manifold tuning valve fitted (MtvTiming in the PIT code)
Options0335.2: EGR spark scaled (EgrSparkScaled); also used by PartThrottleFuelCalc

Options0337.7: per-event spark on (EventSparkOn); also the cam signal handling (Isr_GPT_IC4OC5, CamSignalCheck)
Options0337.0: idle dip kick mode (IdleDipKickMode); also EquipmentInit and EquipmentDetect

Options0338.1: alternative field control: ChargeControl2 instead of ChargeControl in the PIT code (FieldControlAlt)

Options0339.3: alternative purge duty off closed throttle (PurgeDutyAltOther)
Options0339.2: alternative purge duty at closed throttle (PurgeDutyAltClosed)

Options033A.7: idle flare check off (IdleFlareCheck skips when set)
Options033A.0: start injector / spark variant (StartInjectorPulse, FinishFuelPulse, SparkEventCalc)

Options033B.6: selects a branch in Isr_GPT_IC1 (purge flag at stall)
Options033B.4: purge flow monitor on (PurgeFlowControl, PurgeVaporLoad, PurgeMonStep)

Options033E.1: leak detection pump fitted (LDP monitor and tests; start and closed-loop branches)

Options033F.7: heater monitor for O2 sensor 1 supported (O2HeaterMonitor, ObdReadiness)
Options033F.6: heater monitor for O2 sensor 2 supported
Options033F.5: heater monitor for O2 sensor 3 (downstream 1) supported
Options033F.4: heater monitor for O2 sensor 4 (downstream 2) supported

Options0340.5: brake switch, VSS and purge flow monitors variant

PurgeFlags.7: purge vapour learn done for this cycle (PurgeVaporLearn); cleared by PurgeMain
PurgeFlags.5: per-event correction asked for purge to stop (EventCorrections)
PurgeFlags.4: purge held off: rev limit or bit 5 (PurgeEnable)
PurgeFlags.3: purge trim counted for the current cell (PurgeRampControl)
PurgeFlags.1: battery temperature at or above PurgeBattTempMax (PurgeEnable)
PurgeFlags.0: battery temperature between PurgeBattTempMin and PurgeBattTempMax: timer started (PurgeEnable)

PurgeFlowTestFlags2.7: O2 switch state reached the last cell row (O2SwitchState)
PurgeFlowTestFlags2.6: purge test restore delay running: closed loop waits (PurgeFlowTest, ClosedLoopManager)
PurgeFlowTestFlags2.5: fan relay 2 on during the purge test (ControlFlags944 bit 3)
PurgeFlowTestFlags2.4: fan relay on during the purge test (ControlFlags944 bit 4)
PurgeFlowTestFlags2.3: bus A/C message bit 4 clear during the purge test (AcFlags bit 2)
PurgeFlowTestFlags2.2: A/C engaged during the purge test (AcFlags bit 6)
PurgeFlowTestFlags2.1: idle target raise active during the purge test (IdleFlags bit 6)

PurgeMonFlags.6: set with bit 7 when the monitor arms

SecurityFlags.7: security message of the first kind received (CcdReceive); SkimState reads it
SecurityFlags.6: security/SKIM message received recently (CcdReceive, PciReceive; cleared by SkimState)
SecurityFlags.5: SKIM state count past $14: engine start blocked, probably (StarterCut, CrankFuel, EventCorrections read it)
SecurityFlags.0: security status to be sent (CcdReceive, SecurityStatusCalc)

SensorFaultFlags.7: coolant sensor fault (P0117, P0118 or P0125 set): coolant default in use
SensorFaultFlags.5: MAP sensor fault (P0106, P0107, P0108 or P1297 set): limp MAP in use
SensorFaultFlags.4: throttle sensor fault (ProcessThrottle, P0121 and the circuit codes)
SensorFaultFlags.3: air temperature sensor fault (P0112 or P0113)
SensorFaultFlags.0: battery temperature sensor fault (P1492 or P1493)

SensorFaultFlags2.3: upstream O2 sensor 1 circuit fault (P0131 or P0132): sensor not used
SensorFaultFlags2.2: upstream O2 sensor 2 circuit fault (P0151 or P0152)

SkimFlags.2: SKIM present on the bus, probably
SkimFlags.1: SKIM state to be written to the EEPROM (SkimState)
SkimFlags.0: SKIM: key not valid / security request pending, probably (set by SkimState and CcdReceive, cleared on a good key)

SparkFaultFlags.5: idle spark hold: cleared when the throttle closes, on a gear change or by a diagnostic command; read by the spark and idle code
SparkFaultFlags.4: tip-in spark retard finished or blocked (TipInSparkControl)
SparkFaultFlags.1: surge spark correction active (SurgeControl, set with bit 0)
SparkFaultFlags.0: surge spark correction active (SurgeControl, set with bit 1)

SparkFlags.7: set at a reference event while IoInputs0 bit 2 (ASD output present, probably) is high (Isr_GPT_IC1)
SparkFlags.6: reference event handled, rpm update due (Isr_GPT_IC1 -> CalcEngineRpm)
SparkFlags.5: reference period short enough for running spark (RefPeriod below $00FF): surge and after-start spark, dwell

SparkFlags2.7: high vehicle speed spark correction active (HighSpeedSparkFlag, hysteresis HighSpeedSparkOff)
SparkFlags2.4: base spark limited by the value at $0D3E,Z (CalcBaseSpark)
SparkFlags2.3: cleared in Isr_GPT_IC1 when the period is long; not set by bit instructions
SparkFlags2.2: cleared in Isr_GPT_IC1 when the period is long; not set by bit instructions
SparkFlags2.1: low speed and low rpm together (bits 6 and 5): low-speed spark correction (SparkSpeedFlags)
SparkFlags2.0: EGR spark correction applied (EgrSparkCalc, cleared by EgrEnable)

SpeedCtlFlags.7: switch command from bit 5 of the switch byte (SpeedCtlShift)
SpeedCtlFlags.6: switch command from bit 4 of the switch byte (SpeedCtlShift)
SpeedCtlFlags.5: switch command from bit 3 of the switch byte (SpeedCtlShift)
SpeedCtlFlags.2: cleared on engage (SpeedCtlControl); read by SpeedCtlShift

SpeedCtlState.7: speed control off: not engaged or cancelled (set at reset and on cancel)
SpeedCtlState.5: set at reset, on cancel and on engage; meaning not settled

SwitchInputs.0: brake switch (BrakeSwitchMonitor, idle, speed damping, purge test)

SwitchInputs2.7: switch input used by EquipmentDetect and AcClutchControl (A/C request, probably)
SwitchInputs2.6: switch input used by the idle air code (load switch, probably power steering or A/C)
SwitchInputs2.5: park/neutral switch (gear state, starter cut, park/neutral monitor)

SystemFlags945.7: QSPI transfer running (set by QspiSendFrame, cleared by QspiService)
SystemFlags945.6: QSPI command RAM reloaded for an output driver status read, probably (QspiOutputStatus)
SystemFlags945.5: EEPROM transfer on the QSPI in progress (EepromReadByte, EepromPowerDownWrite)
SystemFlags945.4: knock chip configured (KnockChipConfig); cleared before a new window is set
SystemFlags945.2: switch inputs to be collected at the end of the QSPI frame (QspiService)
SystemFlags945.1: QSPI frame sent, end not seen yet (QspiSendFrame, QspiCheck)

ThrottleState.7: throttle open: above the learned closed position plus a margin (hysteresis when set)
ThrottleState.4: closed position stepped to a new minimum, probably (ThrottleClosedLearn only)
ThrottleState.3: closed position taken from the calibration default, probably (ThrottleClosedLearn only)
ThrottleState.1: set by a diagnostic bus request (BusDataRequest), cleared by IdleRpmTarget or another request; probably a test hold of idle and spark
ThrottleState.0: idle: closed throttle and vehicle speed below IdleRollSpeed (IdleStateUpdate)

VssFlags.4: vehicle speed reading valid (set at reset and by CalcVehicleSpeed)
VssFlags.3: new VSS period to process (Isr_GPT_IC3, cleared by CalcVehicleSpeed)
VssFlags.2: mileage step reached: SRI mileage to be stored (Isr_GPT_IC3, SriMileageStore)
